items.title: Xingyao Group · New Media Operations
items.titleZh: 星耀集团 · 新媒体运营
items.summary: Ran content for a fire-safety brand (Huiyou) across Douyin, Xiaohongshu and three e-commerce stores — from script to shoot, edit, publish and weekly data review.
items.summaryZh: 为消防安全品牌“汇友”做抖音、小红书与三个电商店铺的内容：从脚本、拍摄、剪辑到发布与每周数据复盘。

metrics.label: campaign sales via content
metrics.labelZh: 活动期账号带动销售额

chapters.title: Goal
chapters.text: Make a low-interest category (fire extinguishers, car safety tools) worth watching, and turn views into store visits and sales.
chapters.textZh: 让灭火器、车载安全锤这类低关注度品类变得“值得看”，并把播放转化为店铺访问与成交。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Wrote, shot and edited short videos for the Douyin accounts “Director Xia’s Day” and “Huiyou Fire”; ran the Xiaohongshu account independently; built a content calendar by product and holiday; wrote e-commerce copy; shortlisted and contacted 6 KOL/KOCs against budget and engagement, closing 2 collaborations.
chapters.textZh: 负责抖音账号“夏主任的一天”“汇友消防”的写、拍、剪；独立运营小红书账号；按产品和节日节点排内容日历；撰写电商文案；按预算与互动率筛选建联 6 位 KOL/KOC，达成 2 位合作。

chapters.title: Result
chapters.text: Followers +15.6% and engagement rate +11.2%; one account gained 500+ followers in a week; campaign-period sales driven by the accounts rose 12%. The reports below show how each store and channel was tracked.
chapters.textZh: 粉丝增长 15.6%，互动率提升 11.2%；其中一个账号一周涨粉 500+；活动期间账号带动销售额增长 12%。下方报表展示了每个店铺与渠道的追踪方式。

items.title: ZEEKR · Owner Events & Community Content
items.titleZh: 极氪 · 车主活动与社区内容
items.summary: Owner events and community content at ZEEKR, including campaigns organised for sister brand Lynk & Co within Geely.
items.summaryZh: 极氪车主活动与社区内容运营，也参与组织吉利旗下兄弟品牌领克的部分活动。

chapters.title: Goal
chapters.text: Bring in new owners through offline events, and keep existing owners talking and posting in the community.
chapters.textZh: 用线下活动带来新车主，同时让老车主在社区里持续互动、愿意发内容。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Ran events such as the ZEEKR 001 Old Friends Meet-up, co-branding events and the Autumn New Owner Night: materials, staffing, on-site flow, then promotion through the app community, owner groups and social media, in step with 100+ customer-service staff. Designed UGC incentives (points, badges), planned 3 owner discussion topics, and made 80+ short videos.
chapters.textZh: 执行 001 老友见面会、异业合作、秋日新车主之夜等活动：物料、人员分工、现场流程；再通过 App 社区、车主群和社媒分发推广，联动 100+ 客服同步节奏。设计积分、勋章等 UGC 激励，策划 3 类车主话题，产出 80+ 条短视频。

chapters.title: Result
chapters.text: 192 new users driven directly by events; participation up 10%; 200+ UGC posts and 500+ topic discussions; 500K+ short-video views. A 52-response owner survey fed an optimisation report that lifted core-user retention by 5%.
chapters.textZh: 活动直接驱动 192 名新用户，参与率提升 10%；产出 200+ 篇 UGC，话题讨论破 500；短视频累计播放 50 万+。基于 52 份车主问卷输出优化报告，核心用户留存提升 5%。

items.title: Rush Outdoor · #RushOutdoor UGC & Trips
items.titleZh: 热石户外 · #RushOutdoor 话题与线路活动
items.summary: Got trip participants to post about their trips, and packaged routes and themed events so more people signed up.
items.summaryZh: 让参加线路的用户主动发内容，同时包装线路与主题活动，带动更多报名。

chapters.title: Goal
chapters.text: Turn one-off trip participants into people who post, follow and come back.
chapters.textZh: 把一次性参加活动的用户，变成会发内容、会关注、会再来的人。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Built a voucher-based UGC incentive and a weekly feedback loop. Packaged routes such as “Heart of the Earth” and “Starry Sky” with highlights and safety notes, reworked route tags, and ran themed trips (Pingtan Blue Tears, Liyang Wild Ride) with trip-plus-gear bundles. Turned user feedback into 3 PRDs and supported the cold start of gear rental.
chapters.textZh: 以代金券为核心设计 UGC 激励，搭建每周反馈收集机制。包装“地球之心”“星空旅行”等线路的亮点与安全须知，优化路线标签；策划“平潭蓝眼泪”“溧阳野骑”主题活动并设计“行程 + 装备”套餐。把用户反馈整理成 3 份 PRD，参与装备租赁功能冷启动。

chapters.title: Result
chapters.text: 40+ quality UGC notes, 20+ converted to brand followers; #RushOutdoor topic reached 18K views and 273 discussions; Xiaohongshu account 50K+ reads, +2,300 followers and 2 viral posts. Route search efficiency +20%, a slow route’s sign-ups recovered 35%, and single themed trips passed 60 sign-ups.
chapters.textZh: 40+ 篇优质用户笔记，转化 20+ 人关注品牌账号；#RushOutdoor 话题浏览 1.8 万、讨论 273；小红书账号阅读 5 万+、涨粉 2300+、爆款 2 篇。线路查找效率提升 20%，滞销线路报名回升 35%，主题活动单场报名破 60 人。

chapters.text: A small independent shop needs content that feels like a customer’s recommendation, not an ad. Footage is shot on site; the shop has agreed to the videos being shown here. The finished edit will be added soon.

modules.introZh: 两种了解用户的方式：看数据，和直接问用户。
modules.description: A data-driven campaign at DiDi and a user-research case at Joy Media.
modules.descriptionZh: 滴滴的数据驱动大促，与无忧传媒的用户调研案例。

items.title: DiDi · Spring Festival Charging Campaign
items.titleZh: 滴滴 · 小桔充电春节大促
items.summary: Designed coupon packages for the Spring Festival campaign on DiDi’s Xiaoju Charging app, then pulled and reviewed the results with SQL.
items.summaryZh: 为小桔充电 App 春节大促设计券包，并用 SQL 独立取数复盘活动效果。

metrics.label: target-group conversion during the campaign
metrics.labelZh: 活动期间目标人群转化率提升

metrics.label: recommendation strategy rollouts
metrics.labelZh: 次推荐策略配置与上线

chapters.title: Find the users who matter
chapters.text: Split private-car drivers by lifecycle — new, returning and lapsed — and looked at where each group dropped off before their first or next charge.
chapters.textZh: 按生命周期把私家车用户分为新客、回流、流失等人群，找出每类人群在首充或复充前的流失环节。

chapters.title: Design the incentive
chapters.text: Built tiered coupon packages for each group, set budgets and timing, and configured them across in-app placements and push channels. Alongside the campaign, ran the homepage recommendation strategy (station matching, top-11 slot ranking), collecting regional requests every two weeks.
chapters.textZh: 为不同人群设计阶梯券包，确定预算与发放节奏，并配置到端内资源位与触达渠道。同时负责首页“人站匹配”推荐策略与前 11 坑位排布，每两周收集区域诉求并上线配置。

chapters.title: Measure and review
chapters.text: Pulled campaign data with SQL and wrote the review: target-group conversion rose about 30 percentage points during the campaign. The review was shared with the team as the baseline for later campaigns (December promotion, weekend half-price charging).
chapters.textZh: 用 SQL 独立取数并输出复盘报告：活动期间目标人群转化率提升约 30pp。报告同步团队，作为后续 12 月大促、周末五折充等活动的参考基线。

items.sourceNote: Company figures are confidential; only relative results are shown and no internal documents are reproduced.
items.sourceNoteZh: 公司数据保密，仅展示相对结果，不复现任何内部文档。

items.title: Joy Media · Small-U User Research
items.titleZh: 无忧传媒 · 小U需求调研
items.summary: Talked to the directors and designers who used Small-U, the company’s internal AI tool, and turned their needs into product improvements.
items.summaryZh: 对接使用公司内部 AI 工具“小U”的编导与设计人员，把他们的需求转化为产品优化方向。

chapters.title: Listen
chapters.text: Ran questionnaires and one-to-one conversations covering script writing, adapting viral short-video formats and poster design, collecting 150+ needs.
chapters.textZh: 通过问卷和一对一沟通，覆盖脚本撰写、爆款视频复制、海报设计等场景，收集 150+ 条需求。

chapters.title: Prioritise
chapters.text: Grouped the needs into 7 core optimisation points, such as script-structure guidance and creator-persona tags, and gave 8 test suggestions on script coherence and poster-template fit before launch.
chapters.textZh: 归纳出“脚本结构建议”“达人人设标签”等 7 个核心优化点；上线前测试中针对脚本连贯性、海报模板适配性提出 8 条调整建议。

chapters.title: Prove it
chapters.text: Tracked weekly usage and approval rates and analysed 30+ feedback entries: script generation became 30% more efficient and poster design time dropped 25%.
chapters.textZh: 每周追踪使用频次与内容通过率，分析 30+ 条使用反馈：脚本生成效率提升 30%，海报设计时间缩短 25%。

modules.description: One working prototype and one product in progress, both grown out of real operations and marketing work.

items.title: Small-U Feedback Assistant
items.summary: A prototype that turns scattered user needs and feedback into clear product insights — inspired by my Small-U operations work at Joy Media.
items.summaryZh: 把分散的用户需求与反馈整理成清晰产品洞察的原型，灵感来自我在无忧传媒的小U运营工作。

chapters.title: Why build it
chapters.text: At Joy Media, user needs and feedback were scattered across chats and documents. This prototype connects them to clear product opportunities.
chapters.textZh: 在无忧传媒时，用户需求与反馈分散在聊天和文档里。这个原型把它们连接成清晰的产品机会。

chapters.title: Who it is for
chapters.text: Product and operations teams. It covers survey setup, AI-drafted questions based on product context, editing and review, publishing, and an anonymised feedback dashboard showing team-level patterns and recurring themes.
chapters.textZh: 面向产品与运营团队。覆盖问卷配置、基于产品上下文生成候选题目、编辑审核、发布，以及展示团队分布与高频主题的脱敏反馈看板。

chapters.title: My contribution
chapters.text: I shaped the positioning, information architecture and workflow, and built the interactive web prototype myself. Next: trace every recommendation back to its evidence and add a human review step.
chapters.textZh: 我独立完成产品定位、信息架构、业务流程，并亲手搭建了交互式 Web 原型。下一步：让每条产品建议可追溯到原始证据，并加入人工复核。

chapters.title: Try the demo
chapters.text: Try survey setup, question drafting, review, publishing and the dashboard. The dashboard uses anonymised real data — 50+ of the 150+ needs collected at Joy Media. Drafting and publishing are simulated in the browser; no live AI service or Feishu form is connected. The interface is in Chinese.
chapters.textZh: 可体验问卷配置、题目生成、审核、发布与数据看板。看板使用真实数据脱敏后的样本——无忧传媒收集的 150+ 条需求中的 50+ 条。题目生成与发布为浏览器内模拟，未接入在线 AI 服务或飞书表单。

items.reflection: Skills shown: user research, feedback analysis, product operations, AI product design.
items.reflectionZh: 体现能力：用户研究、反馈分析、产品运营、AI 产品设计。

chapters.title: Two ways in
chapters.text: Build a campaign from scratch — brand, audience and goal in; campaign idea, growth strategy and content plan out — or paste an existing plan and get suggestions to improve it.

chapters.title: What makes it different
chapters.text: Every example starts from a real campaign I worked on, so visitors can edit the brief and see how the plan changes. Real cases and AI-generated suggestions are labelled separately.
chapters.textZh: 每个示例都从我参与过的真实活动出发，访客可以修改简报，查看方案如何变化。真实案例与 AI 生成建议分开标注。
